rationale: LRCX is positioned to compound on AI-driven semicap demand with 23.8% revenue growth, 40.8% earnings growth, and 66.8% ROE backed by $4.35B free cash flow. HBM capacity ramps and DRAM pricing power support continued multiple expansion.

Nubank's 60.9% earnings growth and 43.9% revenue growth, paired with a 30.3% ROE and 41% profit margins, demonstrate LatAm fintech scaling at exceptional pace. The forward P/E of 12.6 versus trailing 25 signals massive earnings acceleration ahead.

EQT is the largest US natural gas pure-play trading at 12.55x forward PE with 49.9% revenue growth, 35.07% profit margins, and $2.5B in free cash flow. AI/data-center power demand is a structural multi-year tailwind with 80.97% gross margins supporting durable earnings power.

Booking Holdings trades at a forward P/E of just 14.0 despite 38.4% earnings growth and 16% revenue growth, with elite 87.4% gross margins and $6.55B in free cash flow. The summer 2026 travel season and continued international expansion are near-term catalysts.

nVent's electrical infrastructure business delivers 41.8% revenue growth and 11.1x earnings growth, driven by AI/data-center liquid cooling and electrical protection demand. The 51% 6-month momentum confirms institutional accumulation at a reasonable 27.9x forward PE given growth.

Trane Technologies is a high-quality HVAC compounder riding secular tailwinds in decarbonization and data center cooling, with elite 36.96% ROE and $1.94B in free cash flow. Momentum of +13.7% 1M and +14.1% 6M signals quality accumulation at 28.5x forward PE.
